description: Header file defining the android::os::ParcelableHolder class, which implements parcelable functionality for Android's binder IPC mechanism, including methods for setting and getting parcelable objects, and managing internal parcel data.

classes.name: ParcelableHolder
classes.description: A C++ implementation of the Java class android.os.Parcelable, managing parcelable objects with support for setting, getting, and parceling data, including stability management.

methods.name: writeToParcel
methods.description: Serializes the ParcelableHolder object into a Parcel.

methods.name: readFromParcel
methods.description: Deserializes data from a Parcel into the ParcelableHolder object.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the internal state, clearing parcelable data.

methods.name: setParcelable
methods.description: Sets the parcelable object, either via perfect forwarding or shared pointer, with type safety and stability check.

methods.name: getParcelable
methods.description: Retrieves the stored parcelable object if compatible and available.

methods.name: getStability
methods.description: Returns the stability level of the ParcelableHolder.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the ParcelableHolder.
